analysis:
This batch changes residency and availability behavior for selected-model recovery. No changed line touches encryption, attestation, keys or the prefix cache (T-041 is unaffected).

Changes examined:
1. ProviderLoop+Autopilot.swift:213 (head) calls noteSelectedModelUnloaded after each successful victim unload. This happens under command ownership checks (lines 201, 208).
2. AutopilotBusy.swift:22 (head) adds selectedModelRecovery.attempt as a .preload busy reason. This makes admission more conservative (fail-closed), and the reason is self-reported (A-018).
3. AutopilotControl.swift:80 (head) sets savedEnabledModels from the operator config file on every refresh. The operator already controls residency (TB-003), so this adds no new privilege.
4. New file ProviderLoop+SelectedModelPlacementPolicy.swift:
   - adoptionReleaseTime (lines 22-34) returns nil unless the model is unprotected, has a valid adoption, is unheld and is excluded only by serving reasons. It honours holds, minimum dwell and lease.
   - releaseAdoptionForSelectedModelRecovery (lines 39-52) withdraws the adoption and lets in-flight requests finish. It then publishes a snapshot and a heartbeat.
   - This matches the T-059 expectation that requests are not killed mid-stream. The impact is availability-only (A-018).
5. ProviderLoop+Capacity.swift:82 (head) awaits checkSelectedModelRecoveryIfDue before superviseServingAuthorization in capacityRefreshTick.

Open question for integration:
- The ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery implementation was not supplied. If checkSelectedModelRecoveryIfDue awaits a long model load or eviction inline, it could delay superviseServingAuthorization on every tick. That would delay expiry or revocation supervision (TB-011/T-053).
- This would also run against the 2026-10-10 note that model work must not delay connection control.
- Verify that the recovery check is bounded or spawns a task.
- Also confirm that recovery-driven loads respect the add-on hold and model-load fence (TB-012/T-059). Recovery must not load models while addonHoldActive is set or during drain.

No concrete regression was established from the visible source.
